definitions.explanation: Describes fruit or crops that have not fully ripened.
Describes a person whose skills, knowledge, or character are not yet fully developed.

examples.japanese: {未熟|みじゅく}な⟦{果実|かじつ}→果実：00146_kajitsu⟧。
⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{未熟|みじゅく}な⟦トマト→トマト：05192_tomato⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{食|た}べない→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: It's better not to eat tomatoes that aren't ripe yet.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{品種|ひんしゅ}→品種：11840_hinshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{未熟|みじゅく}な⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{収穫|しゅうかく}→収穫：03207_shuukaku⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: This variety is often harvested while still unripe.

examples.japanese: ⟦まだまだ→まだまだ：10505_madamada⟧⟦{未熟|みじゅく}→未熟：13015_mijuku⟧です。
{未熟|みじゅく}な⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦されたくない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I don't want to be operated on by an unskilled doctor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{未熟|みじゅく}なうち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{積|つ}めば→積む：02294_tsumu⟧⟦{上達|じょうたつ}する→上達する：17981_joutatsusuru⟧。
examples.english: While your skills are still undeveloped there will be many mistakes, but with experience you'll improve.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{未|み}→未〜：00277_mi⟧ (not yet) + {熟|じゅく} (ripe/mature). The word connects the literal sense of unripeness with the figurative sense of human immaturity. Sense 2 is far more common in everyday usage.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {未熟|みじゅく}な⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧: undeveloped skill
- {未熟|みじゅく}な⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧: immature judgment
- {未熟|みじゅく}な⟦{者|もの}→者：12734_mono⟧: inexperienced person
- ⟦まだまだ→まだまだ：10505_madamada⟧⟦{未熟|みじゅく}→未熟：13015_mijuku⟧: still very inexperienced (humble self-description)

USAGE:
When used about oneself, it functions as a humble expression acknowledging one's lack of skill. ⟦まだまだ→まだまだ：10505_madamada⟧⟦{未熟|みじゅく}→未熟：13015_mijuku⟧です is a common phrase used when receiving praise.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{未経験|みけいけん}→未経験：17726_mikeiken⟧: inexperienced — focuses on lack of experience rather than lack of skill development
- {若|わか}い: young — can imply inexperience but without the negative skill connotation
- ⟦{半人前|はんにんまえ}→半人前：22681_hanninmae⟧: half-baked, not yet fully trained — implies being halfway to competence
- ⟦{熟練|じゅくれん}→熟練：09081_jukuren⟧: skilled, experienced — the opposite of ⟦{未熟|みじゅく}→未熟：13015_mijuku⟧
